Context: Forwarding of applications, etc.

## Forwarding of applications, etc.  
Application of a Government servant for appointment, whether by Direct Recruitment, transfer on deputation or transfer, to any other post should  
not be considered/forwarded if he is under suspension.  
- GID (19), Chapter 3.  
Vigilance clearance may not be granted to an officer under suspension for deputation, empanelment, etc.DoP&T, O.M. No. 11012/11/2007-Estt. (A), dated 14-12-2007 and 21-6-2013.
